About the Project

Noor (نور — "light" in Arabic) is my first mobile application built with React Native. Designed to support Muslim practitioners in their daily life, it brings together spiritual habit tracking, GPS-calculated prayer times, a Qibla compass, and an authentic du'as library.

The interface adopts a premium white aesthetic: ivory tones, golden accents, soft shadows. The dark mode draws inspiration from nighttime mosques with a deep night green. The app is entirely local — no account, no network connection required.

Key Features

Habit Tracking

Check off daily spiritual acts with a confetti animation when the goal is reached.

Prayer Times

Astronomical GPS calculation (UOIF, MWL, ISNA). Real-time countdown.

Statistiques & Streaks

Calendar heatmap, consecutive days, per-habit progress over 30 days.

Qibla Compass

Interactive SVG ring with an "Aligned ✓" badge within ±6° of Mecca.

Fortress of the Muslim

14 authentic du'as (Bukhari, Muslim…) with Arabic text and English translation.

Auto Dark Mode

Automatically switches at Maghrib time. Night green theme inspired by mosques.

Tech Stack

React Native 0.74 Expo SDK 51 TypeScript 5.3 React Navigation 6 AsyncStorage react-native-svg expo-notifications expo-location PrayTimes Algorithm

Architecture

  • 100% local — no external server
  • React ThemeContext for global dark/light mode
  • AsyncStorage — encrypted key/value persistence
  • Integrated astronomical algorithm (Julian Day)
  • Metro stubs for full web compatibility
